$comment: Pre-existing duplicate CREATE TABLE definitions, pinned to the exact set of files that define each table. Each entry is a defect to be reconciled per ADR-0006, not an approved pattern. A NEW table collision, or a NEW file defining an already-colliding table, fails CI. Shrink this file; never grow it. Standing exceptions (documented in ledger C-8/C-10/C-11): entries whose only rival is a dead root-lineage 0010 file — their canonical DDL lives in db/migrations/20260725_* and ADR-0006 retirement of the dead files removes the entries.
$note_on_the_2026_09_10_jump: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING THIS FILE TO AN OLDER COPY. The count went 34 -> 60 -> 27 on 2026-09-10, and the middle number is the honest one. The 34 -> 60 step added no definition: the guard was fixed. Its CREATE TABLE pattern required a bare word after the optional IF NOT EXISTS, so a leading double quote failed the match outright — and drizzle-kit generate quotes everything. migrations/0000_sweet_joseph.sql, the drizzle baseline, holds 297 CREATE TABLE statements, sits in the root migrations/ tree that install-fresh’s overlay walks, and was counted by this guard as creating NOTHING. Distinct tables seen went 1150 -> 1416. Proved by making it fail: with the old pattern, and a probe file adding a QUOTED second definition of q_submissions, the guard scanned 586 files and reported "34 defined more than once" and a green tick. The 60 -> 27 step is real work: WO-1 stage 2 archived 18 files that no applier runs (see db/migrations/_legacy/README.md, 2026-09-10 section), then amended migrations/0012_project_charter_timeline.sql and migrations/20260524_c2c_blockers.sql in place. EVERY REMAINING ENTRY IS CLASSIFIED in $reasons below — parked, blocked, not-a-defect, or named work. There is no "unreviewed" category here; an entry without a reason is the thing that field exists to prevent. The shrink rule holds from 27. 12 are cortex.* and cannot shrink until WO-14 decides; one (c2c_template_specs) is not a defect at all.

$reasons.c2c_template_specs: NOT A DEFECT. Verified byte-identical modulo comments: migrations/20260716_template_doc_types.sql repeats 20260531’s CREATE TABLE, same 15 columns, same PK, same CHECK, same constraint name, same three indexes — as a deliberate guard so its ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN doc_types applies on a preview branch that predates the base table. Its own header says so. There is no rival shape and none can arise. The REAL finding here is a reachability gap, not a duplicate: c2c_template_specs has no drizzle definition and neither file is in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES, so doc_types reaches no populated database — WO-15 finding 5. Left in this baseline because the guard cannot distinguish an identical guard from a rival; do not "fix" it by deleting the guard.
$reasons.compliance_tracking: HAND-WRITTEN DDL COMPETING WITH THE DRIZZLE BASELINE. The rival is migrations/0000_sweet_joseph.sql, which drizzle-kit generated from shared/schema.ts. These five became visible on 2026-09-10 when the guard was fixed to match quoted identifiers; they were always real. This is ledger C-29’s class: two shapes for one table, one of them the ORM’s. Resolving each needs a column-level diff of the hand-written file against shared/schema.ts and against a live database, because 0000 is a point-in-time snapshot and shared/schema.ts has moved since. Not yet done.

$reasons.core.programs: WO-15 FINDING 1 — the most serious thing in this file. 000_gcc_bootstrap_core.sql (9 columns) is on install-fresh step 6 and CI’s psql loop; 044b_gcc_lumen_schema_prerequisite.sql (7 columns, no metadata, no created_by) is on DEPLOY-MIGRATE at index 11. org_id comes from a third file, 069_gcc_multitenant_rls_expansion.sql, which is on no applier. Step 6 is the ONLY non-fatal step in install-fresh, so a missing psql leaves 044b to create a 7-column core.programs with no org_id — permanently, since no ALTER on any applier repairs it. Six consumers break, and server/routes/innovation-routes.ts:118-143 catches the 42703 and returns null, rendering a failed cross-tenant check as a clean "no match". Do NOT remove this entry to make the count smaller: removing it fails ci.yml:91 while both CREATEs remain.

$reasons.risk_controls: BLOCKED ON A PRODUCT DECISION — ledger C-29, and NOT dead text. migrations/20260609_design_risk.sql is in install-fresh’s CLASSIFIED_OVERLAY_SKIPS: its CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS risk_items succeeds as a no-op against the pushed shape, then statement 27 (line 167, CREATE INDEX ... ON risk_items (rmf_id)) raises 42703, and since each overlay file is one transaction NONE of its 30 statements survives. Nothing in the repository ever adds rmf_id, so the deferral can never resolve. Removing the two rival CREATEs here would not change that and would leave the file incoherent. C-29’s required decision — "rename ONE side’s tables or reconcile the models" — is still open for design-risk; the IVDR half was decided 2026-08-13. See WO-15 finding 4: the router is mounted and all 20 endpoints fail.
